mentions.name: ShotOn
mentions.description: Client-side web app that makes photos share-ready by adding "shot on" watermarks and photo frames using camera metadata from EXIF data, plus film-simulation-style filters. A browser-based camera mode is in development, with WebGL being considered for smooth real-time filtering on the live camera feed.
mentions.problem: Making photos share-ready with watermarks and filters otherwise requires downloading another app.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building ShotOn (https://shoton.app/) – make your photo share ready in a few clicks without downloading another app.

It basically is a client side web app that adds "shot on" watermarks / photo frames with camera metadata from EXIF data. Also have film simulations like filters to elevate you photo.
